verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a SaaS tax platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only one-off API calls (transaction sync, ephemeral tax estimates, filings fetch) and vendor-managed automation such as done-for-you filing and early alerts. None of it documents a user-configurable recurring schedule for jobs or workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
